info.headline: Rain-wind-hailstorm/thunderstorm predicted in upper/central from weekend
info.description: Punjab/Islamabad: Rain-windstorm/thunderstorm (isolated hailstorm) is expected in Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Bahawalnagar and Lahore during 10th /11th October. Kashmir/Gilgit-Baltistan: Rain-windstorm/thunderstorm (isolated hailstorm) is expected at isolated places in Gilgit-Baltistan (Diamir, Astore, Ghizer, Skardu, Hunza, Gilgit, Ghanche and Shigar) from 10th to 15th October with occasional gaps. Sindh: Mainly hot and dry weather is likely to continue in coming days.
info.instruction: Farmers and travellers are advised to plan accordingly.
